verdicts.reason: A keeps the can as the hero but inverts the hierarchy: the quote is shrunk to body size with an orphaned 'soon.' while the attribution is bigger and bolder than the quote. The logo sits off-axis at top right, the text runs over the lighter circle, and the bottom third is dead space. B is worse. The can shrinks to an unrecognisable orange speck, which loses the product. The quote is tiny single-line text, the attribution outweighs it, and huge empty circles fill most of the canvas.
